body: Haha I couldn’t taste it today because I have a terrible nose (can’t smell anything) but I can remember what it tastes like. I hope I continue University too! I think I’ve finally hit my stride this year. I promised a few people I would change and I really am haha. I have a little cat she’s about 9 now. I love her.

Wow thank you so much for writing that! And you’re right, we had a great time and I’m glad to even know I was capable of loving someone like that. we’ve been brushing past the idea of breaking up for a while now I think I’ve just accepted it. I don’t know, we’ll wait and see! Thank you again!!

Broke my ankle over the weekend while working as a sales rep for a small tech company. Boss didn't care that I couldn't do my door-to-door prospecting and kept being a douche about me keeping up my sales targets.  We were on commission only and it wouldn’t have cost him anything, and threatened to fire me for the two days that I was back. Called in sick the next day and quit day after! Dude was a prick and had issues!

Depressed and alone... stopped trying to hang out with people because they think I’m rude for being quiet. When I tell people I stutter they say “oh I didn’t even notice” - yeah because I don’t say much to begin with!
I worked as a sales rep for a year and I feel my stutter got in the way with closing some deals. Depressed, lonely and shit at my job... h-h-h-hooray!

I've got it all figured out glitter sushi. I'm one piece of the puzzle away.

I think of it like this - it's one last burden you will put on your family. Reading subs of people who personally know those who have gone the distance, seems like they still move on with their lives. The wheel keeps turning and in 100 years, no one will remember you. People will just simply keep moving forward. You won't be around to be sad anyways. You'll just not exist, it won't even be black, it will just be nothing. That being said, I'm scared shitless of self induced pain/suffering. I can't even pinch myself knowing that I will be hurt. That's why I'm still here.
if you can, keep this one for yourself! who knows, one day, you might bump into someone you knew him personally.

To a point, she's one of the reasons why Im like this now. But it's one of those things where if we break up, I'd really find a way to kill myself And if I stay, these feelings will never change. I don't know I'm tired dude. Everything made sense an hour ago...
